note: People born in Guam are United States citizens and hold its passport, at its fees.

sources.title: United States Code, 2023 edition (govinfo.gov), 8 U.S.C. § 1407, Persons living in and born in Guam
sources.said: (b) All persons born in the island of Guam on or after April 11, 1899 (whether before or after August 1, 1950) subject to the jurisdiction of the United States, are declared to be citizens of the United States

sources.title: United States Code, 2023 edition (govinfo.gov), 22 U.S.C. § 212, Persons entitled to passport
sources.said: No passport shall be granted or issued to or verified for any other persons than those owing allegiance, whether citizens or not, to the United States.
